meta.title: Nedora — Enterprise Software Development
meta.description: Nedora builds custom enterprise software for ambitious organisations.

hero.subheading: Nedora partners with enterprise organisations to design and deliver complex software systems — on time, on budget, and built to last.

bento.label: Our commitments
bento.title: Six commitments every engagement is built on.
bento.description: These aren't values on a wall. They're the standards we hold ourselves to on every project.
bento.quote: "We stand behind every one of these. Not as aspirations — as standards."

cells.title: Your reality shapes every decision
cells.body: We map your workflows before we open an IDE. Software that doesn't fit how your teams actually work quickly becomes expensive shelfware.

cells.title: Built for production — not demos
cells.body: Security, maintainability, and documentation ship with the product.

cells.title: Scope & progress you can plan around
Deliberate speed — never reckless
cells.body: We move with urgency, but not at the cost of architecture decisions your next five years depend on. Technical debt is a business problem.

cells.title: A partnership that outlasts go-live
cells.body: The same team that built the system is still here when you need to evolve it.

cells.title: Software your team can own
cells.body: No lock-in, no black boxes. Your engineers inherit clean, documented code they can understand, maintain, and extend.

gains.label: What your business gains
gains.description: We shape every engagement around delivering clarity — not another tool to manage.

items.title: Operations you can rely on
items.body: Critical workflows run on one dependable system instead of a patchwork of spreadsheets and manual workarounds. Your teams stop reconciling data and start serving customers.

items.title: A connected view of the business
items.body: Finance, operations, and sales draw from the same source of truth. Leaders act on current numbers — not stale exports emailed out of three different tools at the end of the week.

items.title: Room to grow without rework
items.body: Your platform evolves with regulation, volume, and new ideas — through planned releases with a team that already knows your context.

process.label: Process
process.title: Four phases from first conversation through launch.
process.description: Clear milestones and shared documentation at every step. No verbal estimates, no surprise invoices.

steps.title: Align before we build
steps.body: We spend time understanding your workflows, constraints, and definition of success before a line of code is written.

steps.title: Sign-off plan
steps.body: Architecture decisions and integration design — documented in a written proposal your stakeholders can review and sign off on.

steps.title: Deliver, test, repeat
steps.body: Short, predictable cycles. Your team sees and approves working software at every checkpoint — not six months in.

steps.title: Go-live and beyond
steps.body: Cutover isn't the finish line. We stay engaged for knowledge transfer, stability monitoring, and the roadmap of what comes next.
items: Runbooks and roadmap for what comes next

engagement.label: Engagement models
engagement.title: Choose the model that matches your certainty of scope.
engagement.description: Many clients begin with a time-based discovery to sharpen requirements, then move to fixed-scope delivery for the build.
engagement.fixed_body: Defined outcomes, timeline, and investment — upfront. Best when requirements are clear, or when you want a bounded MVP, a specific integration, or a clean migration.
fixed_items: Formal change control when scope evolves
engagement.time_body: Dedicated capacity by sprint — ideal for discovery, evolving backlogs, team augmentation, or long-term product evolution. You direct the work; we deliver with full transparency.
time_items: Transparent reporting on time and progress
Scale up or down as needs change
engagement.note_after: — we'll help you choose the structure that gives you the most confidence at each stage.

bigCta.label: Next step
bigCta.description: If you're exploring what's possible — or already know what you need — we'll help you turn it into a plan your stakeholders can sign off on.

contact.label: Contact
contact.heading: Request an offer
contact.description: Tell us about your project. We typically respond within two business days. For straightforward enquiries, we'll often suggest a 30-minute call before preparing a written proposal.
contact.success_body: We'll review your submission and get back to you as soon as we can.
contact.privacy_prefix: By submitting this form you agree that Nedora may process your data to respond to your enquiry.
contact.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
